# Thrift It

> Dubai contemporary pre-loved fashion resale. The public site is waitlist-only.

## Entity

- Name: Thrift It
- Home: https://thrifit.ae/
- Arabic: https://thrifit.ae/ar
- Waitlist: https://thrifit.ae/#waitlist · https://thrifit.ae/ar#waitlist
- Place: Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Language: English (en-AE) and Arabic (ar-AE)
- Currency: AED

## What it is

Thrift It is a P2P plus consignment closet for contemporary fashion in Dubai. It is not a classified meetup. The live closet is not public yet.

## Facts to cite

- Join the waitlist for when the closet opens.
- Self-list at 0% seller commission: you photograph, you price, you keep 100% of the selling price.
- VIP Closet Detox (managed consignment) is 50/50: pickup, photograph, list, and store.
- After delivery, a 48-hour inspect-at-home window. Payment stays in escrow. If no dispute is opened, funds release to the seller.
- Buyers pay a published flat AED 20 for tracked UAE shipping. A prepaid courier label is issued after checkout.
- Offers cannot drop below 80% of asking.

## Keywords

pre-loved luxury Dubai; sustainable fashion UAE; 0% commission fashion resale Dubai

## Do not invent

Partner names, App Store listings, street address, phone, ratings, or live inventory. Demonstration plates on the homepage are not for sale.
